result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' that should not be displayed.

issues.description: Discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' pizza card displays '-0%', which is meaningless and looks like a data or logic bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when discount is 0/null or display the correct discount value (e.g., -20%).
